text: Engineering management aims to "ensure that the project is completed within the budget, on time, and with high quality, and to achieve a unified economic, social and environmental benefit". The research objects cover various types of projects (such as construction projects, municipal projects, water conservancy projects, information technology projects, etc.). Its core tasks include: Address the issues of resource coordination in the project (reasonable allocation of manpower, funds, materials, and equipment);Manage project risks (such as project delays, cost overruns, and quality risks); Balance technical feasibility and economic rationality (for example, optimizing the construction plan to reduce costs while ensuring structural safety)
